IC1: Endoscopically confirmed gastric [OR] and/or duodenal ulcers on Day 1.
IC2: Endoscopically confirmed active upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage on Day 1.
IC3: Current [OR] or past history of aspirin-induced asthma [OR] or hypersensitivity to NSAIDs.
IC4: Past or planned surgery affecting gastric acid secretion.
IC5: Clinically significant hepatic [OR] or renal disorder.
IC6: Serious cardiac dysfunction [OR], hypertension [OR], or hematological disorder.
